title: What is estimated?

choices: the chance of exactly one six in 3 rolls
the chance of a six in one roll
the chance of at least one six in 3 rolls
explanations: `>= 1` also counts two or three sixes.

hints: When does it count a hit?
solution: A hit is a trial of 3 rolls with at least one six: it estimates 1 − (5/6)³.
